columns.name: implementation_verified_at
columns.comment: Time an authorized registry admin attests that the implementation exists; not proof of runtime execution. NULL legacy drafts are excluded from Operations.

columns.name: implementation_verified_at
columns.comment: Time an authorized registry admin attests that this skill implementation exists; no legacy proposals are automatically confirmed.

tables.name: agent_ops.operation_runs
tables.comment: Agent Operations completed RUN_LOG; production only is shown by snapshot. No personal content. Separate from HR and append-only.

tables.name: agent_ops.history_import_batches
tables.comment: Bounded audit scope and per-agent evidence coverage. No-evidence findings are not tasks, and are not proof of no historical work.

tables.name: agent_ops.historical_work_items
tables.comment: Evidence-based historical backfill. Artifact, migration and inspection evidence is not proof a named Agent executed a run. Unknown attribution, timing and skills remain NULL. Excluded from runtime KPIs.

columns.name: evidence
columns.check: jsonb_typeof(evidence) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_array_length(evidence) >= 1 AND jsonb_array_length(evidence) <= 20 AND octet_length(evidence::text) <= 32768
